intro: Watcher Biggs was bound for the eastern coast with a caravan when the lost ones attacked. Biggs alone survived, and now wild creatures skulk near the camp. Biggs asks for your help defending it. This follows Help Watcher Biggs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My caravan was destined for the eastern coast, but we did not reach our goal. Lost Ones attacked us, killing guards and dashing supplies.
I alone survived their assault. I have sworn to protect what supplies remain, but wild creatures skulk near. Please, help me defend my camp from the beasts!

clips.title: Progress
paras: The swamp creatures press close, friend. Please, you must defend the camp!

clips.title: Completion
paras: The sounds of animals are now faint, more distant. Thank you, friend. Now let's hope they don't return!
